heading.en: Remove what you do not need

takeaways.en: Every column and row costs memory and refresh time; remove columns no report uses and rows outside the needed period.
takeaways.zh: 每个列和每一行都消耗内存和刷新时间；删除没有报表使用的列，以及所需期间以外的行。

takeaways.en: High-cardinality columns (GUIDs, timestamps, free text, many decimals) compress worst — remove, split or round them.
takeaways.zh: 高基数的列（GUID、时间戳、自由文本、很多位小数）压缩效果最差——要删除、拆分或四舍五入。

takeaways.en: Turn off Auto date/time and prefer integer keys.
takeaways.zh: 关闭「自动日期/时间」，优先使用整数键。

html.en: Import models are compressed column by column. A column with few distinct values (Country) compresses to almost nothing; a column where every value is different (TransactionGUID, a Date/Time to the second) barely compresses at all. The fastest model is a small one.
html.zh: 导入模型是按列压缩的。非重复值很少的列（国家/地区）几乎不占空间；每个值都不同的列（TransactionGUID、精确到秒的日期/时间）几乎压缩不了。最快的模型就是小的模型。

rows.en: Remove unused columns in Power Query
rows.zh: 在 Power Query 中删除没用的列

rows.en: Fewer columns = less memory, faster refresh
rows.zh: 列越少，内存越少、刷新越快

rows.en: Filter rows to the needed history (e.g. last 3 years)
rows.zh: 把行筛选到需要的历史范围（如最近 3 年）
所有地方的行都会变少

rows.en: Split Date/Time into Date and Time; drop seconds
rows.zh: 把日期/时间拆成日期和时间；去掉秒
降低每列的基数
四舍五入或使用定点小数
减少非重复值

rows.en: Integer surrogate keys instead of long text keys
rows.zh: 用整数代理键代替很长的文字键
关系更小、更快
停用「自动日期/时间」（选项 → 数据加载）

rows.en: Removes hidden date tables for every date column
rows.zh: 移除每个日期列的隐藏日期表

rows.en: Replace calculated columns with Power Query columns
rows.zh: 用 Power Query 列代替计算列
压缩更好
非必要不用双向关系
筛选传递更简单、更快

q.en: Which column is likely to make an Import model much larger than necessary?
q.zh: 哪个列最可能让导入模型变得远比需要的大？

html.en: A Date column used by the date relationship
html.zh: 日期关系使用的日期列

html.en: A unique transaction GUID that no report uses
html.zh: 没有报表使用的唯一交易 GUID

why.en: Right: every value is different and it adds nothing.
why.zh: 对：每个值都不同，而且毫无用处。

heading.en: Performance Analyzer and DAX query view
heading.zh: 性能分析器与 DAX 查询视图

takeaways.en: Performance Analyzer records, per visual, the time spent on the DAX query, visual display and other (waiting).
takeaways.zh: 性能分析器按视觉对象记录 DAX 查询、视觉对象显示和其他（等待）所花的时间。

takeaways.en: Copy a visual's query into DAX query view (or DAX Studio) to test and tune the measure.
takeaways.zh: 把视觉对象的查询复制到 DAX 查询视图（或 DAX Studio）中，测试和调整度量值。

takeaways.en: Slow DAX query → fix the measure or model; slow visual display → too many points or visuals on the page.
takeaways.zh: DAX 查询慢 → 修正度量值或模型；视觉对象显示慢 → 数据点或页面上的视觉对象太多。

items.en: In Desktop open Optimize → Performance analyzer (or View → Performance analyzer).
items.zh: 在 Desktop 中打开优化 → 性能分析器（或「视图 → 性能分析器」）。

items.en: Select Start recording, then Refresh visuals or interact with the page.
items.zh: 选择开始录制，然后刷新视觉对象或与页面互动。

items.en: Expand each visual to see its timings, sorted by duration.
items.zh: 展开每个视觉对象，查看按耗时排序的时间。

items.en: Copy query and paste it into DAX query view to run it, change the measure and compare.
items.zh: 复制查询，粘贴到 DAX 查询视图中执行、修改度量值并比较。

rows.zh: DAX 查询

rows.en: Time for the engine to answer the query
rows.zh: 引擎回答查询的时间

rows.en: Simplify the measure (variables, avoid FILTER on whole tables), check relationships and model size
rows.zh: 简化度量值（用变量、避免对整张表 FILTER），检查关系和模型大小
视觉对象显示
绘制视觉对象的时间

rows.en: Fewer data points, simpler custom visuals
rows.zh: 减少数据点，使用较简单的自定义视觉对象
其他

rows.en: Waiting for other visuals or background work
rows.zh: 等待其他视觉对象或后台工作

rows.en: Fewer visuals on the page; use drill-through or tooltips instead
rows.zh: 减少页面上的视觉对象；改用钻取或工具提示

html.en: DAX query view is a tab in Power BI Desktop where you write EVALUATE queries against the model. It can define measures temporarily in a DEFINE block, run them, and update the model with the improved version. Quick queries (right-click a table or measure) generate starter queries for you.
html.zh: DAX 查询视图是 Power BI Desktop 中的一个选项卡，可以对模型编写 EVALUATE 查询。你可以在 DEFINE 区块中临时定义度量值、执行它们，再把改进后的版本更新到模型。快速查询（右键单击表或度量值）会为你生成起始查询。

blocks.text:
DEFINE
    MEASURE Sales[Total Sales] = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Category], "Sales", [Total Sales] )
ORDER BY [Sales] DESC

html.en: The Optimize ribbon also has Pause visuals (stop queries while you edit) and optimization presets that add an Apply button to slicers and filters, so each click does not send a new query.
html.zh: 优化功能区还有暂停视觉对象（编辑时停止发送查询），以及优化预设：为切片器和筛选器加上「应用」按钮，避免每次点击都发送新查询。

q.en: Performance Analyzer shows a table visual with DAX query 120 ms, Visual display 4,800 ms. What is the most likely fix?
q.zh: 性能分析器显示某个表格视觉对象：DAX 查询 120 毫秒、视觉对象显示 4,800 毫秒。最可能的解决方法是什么？

why.en: That usually makes the query slower.

html.en: Reduce the number of rows or data points the visual renders
html.zh: 减少视觉对象要呈现的行数或数据点

why.en: Right: the query is fast; drawing is slow.
The DAX part is only 120 ms.
why.zh: DAX 部分只有 120 毫秒。

q.en: Where can you run and tune the DAX query that a slow visual generates, without leaving Power BI Desktop?
q.zh: 在不离开 Power BI Desktop 的情况下，可以在哪里执行和调整慢速视觉对象所生成的 DAX 查询？

why.en: Power Query uses M, not DAX queries.
why.zh: Power Query 使用 M，不是 DAX 查询。

takeaways.en: Granularity is what one row of a fact table represents: a transaction, a day per product, a month per store.
takeaways.zh: 粒度是事实表中一行所代表的内容：一笔交易、每个产品每天、每家门店每月。

takeaways.en: If reports never need transaction detail, group the fact table to a coarser grain to cut rows dramatically.
takeaways.zh: 如果报表从不需要交易明细，就把事实表分组到较粗的粒度，可大幅减少行数。

takeaways.en: Keep detail available through DirectQuery or a separate detail table if a few users need it.
takeaways.zh: 如果少数用户需要明细，可以通过 DirectQuery 或另一张明细表提供。

html.en: Reducing granularity (summarising) is the biggest lever for model size. Fifty million sales lines grouped to one row per day, store and product might become two million rows — and every visual that shows daily or monthly figures gives the same answer.
html.zh: 降低粒度（汇总）是缩小模型最有效的方法。五千万行的销售明细，按日、门店和产品分组后可能只剩两百万行——而所有显示每日或每月数据的视觉对象，答案都一样。

items.en: Decide the grain from the questions the report must answer, not from what the source happens to hold.
items.zh: 根据报表必须回答的问题来决定粒度，而不是根据数据源碰巧有什么。

items.en: Group By in Power Query (or in the source view) to the chosen grain; sum the additive numbers, and keep a count if you need averages.
items.zh: 在 Power Query（或数据源视图）中用「分组依据」整理到选定的粒度；对可加总的数字求和，若需要平均值就保留一个计数。

items.en: A coarser fact table can still join the same dimensions, as long as it keeps their keys.
items.zh: 较粗粒度的事实表只要保留维度表的键，仍可连接相同的维度表。

items.en: For huge DirectQuery sources, aggregations keep a small imported summary table that answers most queries, falling back to the detail table only when needed.
items.zh: 对于超大的 DirectQuery 数据源，聚合会保留一张小的导入汇总表来回答大多数查询，只在需要时才回到明细表。

q.en: Reports only ever show sales by day, product and store, but the model imports 80 million transaction rows. What reduces the model most?
q.zh: 报表只会按日、产品和门店显示销售额，但模型导入了 8,000 万行交易数据。哪种做法最能缩小模型？

html.en: Group the fact table by date, product and store in Power Query
html.zh: 在 Power Query 中按日期、产品和门店对事实表分组
